name: Norwalk Apparel Co.
old_description: Whether you're outfitting your staff, promoting your brand, or planning a school event, our team is here to help bring your vision to life. We offer top-quality embroidery and cutting-edge Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing services to give your gear a clean, professional look.
about:
Norwalk Apparel Co. operates from Norwalk, Connecticut, where it was founded by two passionate creatives with backgrounds in branding, apparel design, and small business growth. The founders launched the company to give other local businesses and organizations the tools to represent themselves with confidence and style, staying hands‑on with every order from design to final stitch.

The shop provides embroidery, direct‑to‑film (DTF) printing, and vinyl decal services. DTF transfers are produced on an Epson SureColor G6070 printer, enabling vibrant, full‑color prints on cotton, polyester, blends, and performance fabrics. The company handles orders ranging from a single embroidered polo to large corporate runs, and also supplies wholesale DTF transfers to other print shops.

Customers include businesses outfitting employees with uniforms, schools ordering spirit wear, sports teams needing team apparel, fashion brands producing merchandise, and fellow print shops seeking wholesale transfers. The company also serves organizations and individuals planning events or promotional campaigns.

Norwalk Apparel Co. emphasizes fast turnaround times, competitive bulk pricing, and personalized customer service as a local Connecticut business. Its stated mission is to help small businesses shine by delivering professional‑grade custom apparel and branding solutions.
